80141.processing_notes: Conventional LBL: PM6 in o-xylene, 10 mg/mL, deposited at 1800 rpm; L8-BO solution, 8 mg/mL, deposited at 2000 rpm. These separate feed concentrations do not establish the deposited donor:acceptor mass ratio.

80142.processing_notes: PM6 aqueous nanoparticle ink: 20 mg/mL, spin-coated at 1250 rpm for 1 min in air onto an 80 °C substrate. Residual surfactant removed by three ethanol spin-rinses at 2000 rpm; substrate stored overnight in an N2-filled glovebox. Following donor-layer thermal annealing, L8-BO in o-xylene at 8 mg/mL was spin-coated at 2000 rpm. Toluene was used to rinse PEDOT:PSS before active-layer deposition, not as the active-layer casting solvent. | Annealing: Thermal annealing after L8-BO deposition at 100 °C for 5 min; donor-layer thermal annealing also precedes acceptor deposition.
